remote-backend-engineer-go-endpoint-secu.title: Backend Engineer (Go) – Endpoint Security
remote-backend-engineer-go-endpoint-secu.description:
Description:

  • Join a global enterprise cybersecurity company focused on securing AI agents and LLM-powered applications.
  • Build Go-based endpoint components and backend services for endpoint visibility and security enforcement across various operating systems.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of backend or systems development experience, with 3+ years in Go.
  • Hands-on experience with OS-level programming on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
  • Strong understanding of concurrency, networking, and performance in Go.
  • Working knowledge of Python, gRPC/REST APIs, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud providers.
  • Strong testing discipline across multiple operating systems.
  • Fluent English with strong communication skills.
  • Experience with AI coding assistants is a must.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote-first team.

Benefits:

  • Work on a greenfield product at the intersection of cybersecurity and AI.
  • Solve challenging systems problems at enterprise scale.
  • Take ownership of critical workstreams and influence architecture.
  • Collaborate with a highly technical, distributed team where AI is integral to development.
remote-backend-engineer-go-endpoint-secu.skills: gRPC, Docker, Software as a Service, REST, Kubernetes, GitHub, Web security, Large Language Models, Python, Go

remote-senior-backend-engineer-clera-3.title: Senior Backend Engineer
remote-senior-backend-engineer-clera-3.description:
Description:

  • High-impact individual contributor role on the backend engineering team for an AI-native platform.
  • Design and build intelligent systems for observability, architecture modeling, and AI-driven recommendations.

Requirements:

  • 4+ years of backend engineering experience in high-growth startups or tech companies.
  • Proven experience in designing scalable, distributed systems and microservices architectures.
  • Expertise in Go or Python with a focus on clean, maintainable code.
  • Experience with data pipelines, observability systems, and monitoring infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with DevOps tooling and cloud-native technologies.
  • Familiarity with LLM-based systems and AI workflows.
  • Track record of building systems from inception in startup environments.
  • Skills in performance tuning, debugging, and technical architecture design.
  • Experience with fault-tolerant workflow design in mission-critical services.
  • Strong computer science fundamentals; graduate-level education is a plus.

Benefits:

  • Base salary: $160,000 to $200,000 USD annually, plus equity.
  • Fully remote work environment.
remote-senior-backend-engineer-clera-3.skills: Machine Learning, Large Language Models, Python, Go

remote-senior-platform-engineer-lifen.title: Senior Platform Engineer
remote-senior-platform-engineer-lifen.description:
Description:

  • Join Lifen as a Senior Platform Engineer to enhance cloud-native infrastructure services.
  • Contribute to the development of a secure internal development platform for application deployment and operation.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience in infrastructure, SRE, or Platform Engineering in a demanding production environment.
  • Deep expertise in a cloud service provider (CSP) and management of services like Kubernetes, Object Storage, and Databases.
  • Strong experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform/Terragrunt) and automated deployment pipelines (FluxCD).
  • Significant experience with monitoring tools (Victoria Metrics, Grafana, EFK stack).
  • Problem-solving skills in a dynamic cloud-native environment.
  • Experience working in distributed teams and a collaborative mindset.

Benefits:

  • Work fully remote with a focus on asynchronous communication and team collaboration.
  • Opportunity to impact healthcare data accessibility and improve patient outcomes.
remote-senior-platform-engineer-lifen.jobBenefits: Async collaboration, Distributed team, Flexible working hours, Generous vacation, Unlimited vacation
remote-senior-platform-engineer-lifen.skills: AWS, GCP, Software as a Service, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub, R, Grafana
